user.title: HA AI Agent
user.description: Enter the address of your HA AI Agent container and its chat password (the one it showed once during setup).

data_description.password: If you lost it, reset it on the container's page (Account, Reset chat password) or with hai-agent reset-password.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter the password again
reauth_confirm.description: The HA AI Agent did not accept the saved password. This happens when its chat password was reset or the container was set up again.

hassio_confirm.title: HA AI Agent
hassio_confirm.description: The {name} add-on is running on this Home Assistant. Add it as a conversation agent? Its address and chat password come from the add-on, so there is nothing to type.

error.invalid_url: That is not a valid address. Start with http:// or https://.
error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at that address. Check that the container is running and reachable from Home Assistant.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.container_too_old: This looks like an older HA AI Agent container. Update it (rebuild the image) and try again.
error.container_in_setup: This HA AI Agent container has not finished its setup yet. Open its page (the same address in a browser), complete the setup, then enter the chat password it shows.
error.not_hai_agent: Something answered, but it does not look like an HA AI Agent container.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.invalid_discovery_info: The add-on sent incomplete connection details. Update the add-on, or add it by its address.
